attributes.title: NPACE 2027 Boston: Medical March Madness
attributes.cme_provider: Nurse Practitioner Associates for Continuing Education
attributes.organizer: NPACE (Nurse Practitioner Associates for Continuing Education)
attributes.summary:
NPACE's Boston conference runs Sunday, February 28 to Tuesday, March 2, 2027, at the InterContinental Boston on Atlantic Avenue, with sessions each afternoon from noon to 5:30 pm. The theme is offensive strategies for primary care, with content for advanced practice providers working in team-based care, including medication and drug-interaction updates.

NPACE lists 18+ CE/CME credits. It is an ANCC-accredited provider of nursing continuing professional development and says it will apply for AAPA Category 1 CME credit for PAs. Attendees who stay three or more nights at the conference hotel get $75 off full registration. NPACE's 2027 conference guide lists full conference registration at $800, with discounts for students, military veterans and retired clinicians.
